subject: maths
question: An open tank 15 m long. 12 m wide and 5 m deep is to be constructed with the help of a stainless-steel sheet that is 1.5 m in width. What length (in m) of the sheet will be required?
solution:
Given:

Dimension of the tank = 15 × 12 × 5 (in meters)

Width of the steel sheet = 1.5 m

Concept used:

Surface area of a cuboid = 2 × [Length × Breadth + Length × Height + Breadth × Height]

TSA of the open tank = 2 × [Length × Breadth + Length × Height + Breadth × Height] - Length x Breadth. &l
